uruguayxxi-exports.title: Uruguay XXI · Goods exports by department, 2025 · PDF page 7 (printed page 5)

uruguay:UY-AR.name: Artigas

population.note: INE population estimates and projections, 2025 revision, as reproduced in Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 1.1.4. Published department figures sum one person above the printed national total; retained as published.

area.label: Land area
area.note: Terrestrial area from Servicio Geográfico Militar, published in INE Statistical Yearbook 2025; excludes water and is not calculated from the displayed geometry. The displayed date identifies the yearbook, not a dated boundary survey.

exports.label: Goods exports
exports.note: Uruguay XXI territorial estimate of goods exports, rounded to millions of current US dollars. Uses Customs data and sector-specific allocation by production and final transformation. Includes relevant free-zone production; excludes services. Exports are not GDP. Published departmental values sum to USD 13,484 million, compared with the printed national total of USD 13,494 million; individual values are retained as published.

uruguay:UY-AR.note: Population: 2024 estimate (2025 revision). Land area: INE/SGM 2025 yearbook. Economy: goods exports in 2025, already reported in USD. A recent comparable departmental GDP series has not been verified; export figures are a separate economic measure. Municipality selections do not inherit department totals.
